summary: [FICTIONAL LAB ADVISORY] @bakery/order-notes lacks input validation: anonymous callers can overwrite another customer's order note
details: FICTIONAL advisory written for a lab exercise; it is not a real vulnerability record. @bakery/order-notes 2.1.0 only checks note ownership when the caller supplies a userId. A request that reaches set() without a userId (for example an unauthenticated HTTP request) can overwrite any order's note. The package is abandoned; no fixed version exists. Mitigation: validate the caller and order ownership in application code before calling set().
